messages:
Maya: Uploading vernacular-13b weights + tokenizer to s3://redwood-model-registry/vernacular/vernacular-13b/ . Placing provenance.json, eval_manifest.json, and checksums. Using corp KMS for initial ingest. @Raj PTAL.

Raj: Quick Q — corp KMS or customer-managed? Also add model_catalog tag (e.g. "vernacular-13b-v0.1"). Which model_family/intended_use fields are you setting?

Maya: corp KMS for now. Added metadata fields and model_catalog tag. provenance.json snippet I uploaded:
```
{"origin":"https://partner.example.com/releases/vernacular13b","weights_sha256":"fa3b2...c9","tokenizer_sha256":"d4e1a...8f","license":"cc-by-nd-4.0","uploader":"maya","model_family":"vernacular","intended_use":"multilingual-assistant","eval_manifest":"s3://redwood-model-registry/vernacular/vernacular-13b/eval_manifest.json"}
```
(Note: this is the provenance string I placed, full file in bucket).

ingest-bot: artifact-received | vernacular-13b | weights: 42.3GB | tokenizer: 12.3MB | uploaded_by: Maya | path: s3://redwood-model-registry/vernacular/vernacular-13b/

Lina: Can you also add smoke eval pointers + dataset_licenses + eval_prompt_set names so downstream evals run with the same templates? Even a small dev-run helps.

Maya: Added eval_manifest.json at s3 path. Ran a quick smoke on gp5-16x small-dev: ppl (wiki-small) = 9.4, rouge-l (summ-dev) = 0.44. Logged the run in s3://redwood-model-registry/vernacular/vernacular-13b/evals/smoke/1714010001.log.

Raj: Are the weights fp16 or pre-quantized? We need a quant_plan entry in registry metadata. If fp16, schedule quant trials and keep per-scheme reports.

Maya: Weights are fp16: uploaded weights_fp16.tar.gz. Plan: AWQ-4bit trial + NG-8bit fallback. Command I'm launching for AWQ-4: 
```
./tools/quantize.sh --src s3://redwood-model-registry/vernacular/vernacular-13b/weights_fp16.tar.gz --scheme awq --bits 4 --out s3://redwood-model-registry/vernacular/vernacular-13b/quant/awq4/
```
Will save quant_report.json to the same folder.

Sam: Registry policy: provenance must be signed by asset-signer before final catalog entry. @Maya can you trigger signer CI? Also include dataset_licenses in provenance.

Maya: Triggering asset-signer CI now (token in CI creds).

ingest-bot: signer|queued|job=asset-signer/vernacular-13b
ingest-bot: signer|completed|signed_provenance.json|sha256:abc123def456

Lina: Thanks — also record eval_prompt_set exactly (we use prompt_v2 for summarization + convo_v1 for chat). Add those names to provenance to avoid downstream mismatch.

Maya: Updated provenance with dataset_licenses and eval_prompt_set: ["wiki-corpus-2024-lic-cc", "summ-dev-licensed"], prompt set names: "prompt_v2", "convo_v1". Uploaded signed_provenance.json to bucket.

ops: FYI please set registry lifecycle tags: lifecycle=active, retention=standard-365, backup=glacier-after-90d. If customer requests Dedicated SLA tag, add tag=sla:dedicated. Also ensure KMS key ARNs are recorded.

Raj: Moving this to the prioritization board — bring-up priority: medium. Blockers: full eval suite (all benchmarks), quant_report (per-scheme latency/accuracy), signed provenance (done), and security review for external-origin models. After blockers cleared, schedule canary (suggest gp5-8x canary for 48h).

Maya: Will run full eval + quant experiments. Expect quant_report + full eval logs uploaded by EOD tomorrow. Propose canary start date: 2024-04-04 if no blockers.

Sam: Sounds good. Once quant_report exists, let's run the latency/SLO matrix and pick the rollback thresholds. :thumbsup:

Maya: Noted — I'll include rollout config, canary thresholds, and rollback steps in the registry entry.

Raj: Thanks everyone. Quick reminder: keep all checksums and signed provenance immutable; any follow-up patches need new version tag (e.g., vernacular-13b-v0.2).

Maya: Will do. Posting updates here as each step completes.

Sam: thanks :thumbsup:
